name: Naphish
overview: Naphish was a male member of the tribe named after him, known primarily as the eleventh-born son of Ishmael. His identity is rooted in his lineage as recorded in Genesis 25:15. Beyond this, there are no additional notes or details about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Naphish means "refreshed," reflecting a Hebrew proper name given in the biblical record. This name was not given directly by God but is noted in Genesis 25:15 as part of the genealogy.
familyAndRelationships: Naphish is explicitly identified as a son of Ishmael, making him part of the Ishmaelite lineage. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Naphish's significance lies in his place within the genealogy of Ishmael's descendants, marking the continuation of the Ishmaelite tribes. His birth order as the eleventh son highlights the expansion of Ishmael's family as recorded in the Old Testament. This genealogical detail situates Naphish within God's providential plan for the descendants of Abraham through Ishmael.
